reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 11 points better, in a game of about 217 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 4 points towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Knicks win 70 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 191 and 239 total points.
